set_name: Larkspur Ridge Water District, Operations Building Addition and Yard Improvements, Permit Set 2026-07-30

candidates.notes: Split the batts out to Division 07 21 16 if the estimator's cost code list separates insulation from the partition assembly.

candidates.quote: (2) 12 FT WIDE BY 14 FT HIGH INSULATED SECTIONAL OVERHEAD DOORS WITH ELECTRIC OPERATORS AT THE WASH BAY 101 EXTERIOR WALL.

candidates.candidate: Personnel doors, frames, hardware, and windows

A-601 is a scanned sheet and OCR recovered fewer than twenty words, so no door mark, frame type, or hardware set is confirmed. Stays under review until a native A-601 arrives.

assumptions.text: The existing 12 in ductile iron water main across the site is protected in place and potholed for depth before excavation; no relocation is shown or carried.
Sound attenuation batts named in partition type P1 are carried inside the Division 09 partition assembly rather than separately in Division 07.

exclusions.text: Existing operations building finishes are not in contract.
Special inspections per IBC Chapter 17 are arranged and paid for by the owner.

rfis.text: A-601 is a scanned raster sheet and OCR recovered fewer than twenty words. Request a native PDF of the door and window schedule so door marks, frame types, glazing, and hardware sets can be read.

coverage_ledger.title: Cover Sheet, Sheet Index, and General Notes
coverage_ledger.reason: Sheet index and general notes GN-1 through GN-4 read in full. GN-1 is a standards-only note and carries no work.

coverage_ledger.reason: No scope. Code analysis, occupant load, and the egress diagram only; the sheet says exit signage and emergency lighting are shown diagrammatically for code review and directs devices to the electrical sheets.

coverage_ledger.reason: Three keyed site notes read. Note 3 is protect-in-place of an existing main and was recorded as an assumption, not scope.

coverage_ledger.title: Site Utility Plan
coverage_ledger.reason: Four keyed utility notes read.

coverage_ledger.title: Structural General Notes and Design Criteria
coverage_ledger.reason: No scope. Design criteria, load values, and code references only. The special inspection note assigns that cost to the owner and was recorded as an exclusion.

coverage_ledger.reason: Footing schedule and both foundation notes read.

coverage_ledger.reason: One keyed elevation note read.

coverage_ledger.reason: Finish schedule rows SC-1 and ACT-1 read. Finish note 1 recorded as a blanket exclusion.

coverage_ledger.reason: Scanned raster sheet. OCR recovered fewer than twenty words and no schedule rows. Door, frame, hardware, and window scope stays under review and an RFI is open.

coverage_ledger.reason: Equipment schedule rows RTU-1 and EF-2 and both mechanical notes read.
